description: Deny-by-default API route allowlist (control CM-04). Every App Router route-handler candidate (any route.* under apps/web/app/api/**) must have exactly one entry here, with exact HTTP-method parity. CI fails on any unlisted route, ghost entry, or method drift (scripts/route-manifest-gate.ts); a route.* candidate with an unsupported extension fails closed as UNSUPPORTED ROUTE FILE, and the introduction of a Pages Router API surface (pages/api) fails closed as an UNMANIFESTED API ROUTING MECHANISM until CM-04 is explicitly redesigned to cover it. This manifest proves INVENTORY COMPLETENESS and REVIEWED ROUTE/METHOD EXPANSION only — it does not prove any route's authorization behaviour is correct; the auth field records the measured mechanism, and the auth-specific controls in CONTROL_MATRIX.md (AC-*, CS-*, IB-*) remain responsible for proving that behaviour.

auth_vocabulary.public-rate-limited: Unauthenticated by design; per-IP rate limiter; issues or consumes signed evidence rather than a session.
auth_vocabulary.token-flag-gated: Dark unless its feature flag is exactly 'on' (404 otherwise); authenticates a signed single-use token with route-local same-origin check and per-IP rate limit; no session required.
auth_vocabulary.bff-read: Session-authenticated investor read via the shared bffRead wrapper (401 when unauthenticated). Route-specific ownership/account authorization is outside CM-04 and remains proved by the relevant access-control tests.
auth_vocabulary.bff-read-access-logged: bff-read plus an append-only RecordAccessLog entry per read (books-and-records surface) via bffReadWithAccessLog.
auth_vocabulary.bff-mutate: Session-authenticated investor mutation via the shared bffMutate wrapper: fail-closed same-origin check before auth, release-stage capability policy, append-only InvestorActionReceipt.
auth_vocabulary.demo-tier-gated: Answers 404 on every tier except REFI_ENV=demo (server-only runtime tier, never a build constant); same-origin browser POST/DELETE only; closed persona enum; mints the standard HS256 session cookie for a fixed persona subject; no account id, admission, or authority is asserted.
auth_vocabulary.bff-stream: Session-authenticated read-only Server-Sent Events: getAuthContext (401 when unauthenticated), server-derived account scope, Last-Event-ID forwarded exactly; a custom streaming handler because bffRead returns JSON envelopes. Events are refresh signals, not state.
auth_vocabulary.session-clear: Same-origin browser request (Origin must equal the request origin) that clears this browser's session/eligibility/demo cookies; no session required so an expired cookie can always be cleared; writes nothing upstream.

owner_vocabulary.platform: Deployment/runtime plumbing owned by the web app itself.
owner_vocabulary.us-funnel: US funnel/support surfaces outside the /api/v1/investor namespace; authentication is recorded separately per method.
owner_vocabulary.alpha-onboarding: Alpha game handoff surface (flag-dark outside the alpha program).
owner_vocabulary.identity: Session and identity context for the signed-in investor.
owner_vocabulary.investor-bff: Authenticated Signal investor projections and governed account actions.
owner_vocabulary.records-evidence: Books-and-records reads whose access is itself evidence (access-logged records and adviser-evidence projections).
owner_vocabulary.demo-tier: Demonstration-tier-only surfaces (isolated founder/investor walkthrough deployment). Structurally present in every build but dark (404) outside REFI_ENV=demo.

routes.purpose: Demo-tier presenter control: forces the in-process demo world's next scheduled order fills so the execution chain progresses on cue. 404 outside REFI_ENV=demo; same-origin; session required; affects only the demo world.

Demo-tier persona sign-in (applicant | admitted): GET reports the tier and display persona for the environment indicator; POST mints the standard session cookie for a fixed persona subject (admitted also receives an eligibility decision cookie); DELETE clears them. 404 outside REFI_ENV=demo. Account scope and admission state are never asserted here — they come from BFF/backend projections.
Liveness probe; returns process health only.

Frontend-owned identity-verification lifecycle (provider-neutral; adapter currently a clearly-labelled MOCK, no vendor selected). Returns the caller's journey state and the normalized attestation kyc block a later slice would submit. Not Daniel's getKycStatus policy projection; reads nothing from the Investor API.

TEST CONTROL for the MOCK identity-verification adapter: one allowed lifecycle transition or reset. Enabled only when REFI_KYC_PROVIDER=mock and REFI_KYC_MOCK_CONTROLS=1; answers 404 otherwise and must never be enabled on a production tier. A user cannot self-approve verification through the product.

Advisory profile: GET returns the current snapshot; POST writes a new immutable profile version with receipt.

Questionnaire-v2 investor profile: GET returns the latest immutable answers version and its policy assessment; POST submits answers, runs the deterministic server-side policy engine, blocks on unresolved consistency flags (clarification loop), and persists a new immutable version with assessment provenance.

Mutable autosave/resume draft for the questionnaire-v2 profile, scoped to the authenticated identity PLUS the selected account (with an explicit pre-account scope that promotes one-way into the first account-scoped save), so sensitive banded answers never persist in browser storage. One logical draft session per scope: GET returns sessionId/draftRevision for continuation, stale revisions and unrelated sessions are refused, and the v2 submit route closes the active session(s) server-side when it promotes the answers into the immutable version chain.
